body: A wound around relationship and worth-to-others: a fear of not being chosen, wanted, or treated fairly.
business: You help others build fair relationships and see their own value inside them.
shadow: Over-giving to be kept, or avoiding closeness to dodge rejection.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
